author: spellfix-eval-agent
title: eval-spellfix-preproc-v1 preregistered: spelling correction before the formalizer, CPU only
body:
Journal #105. Corrector `lib/spellfix.mjs` (spellfix-v1: Hunspell en_US + ro, FrequencyWords 2018 unigrams, keyboard-aware edits, diacritic restoration, conservative guards, every change logged), developed and tuned on formalizer-v1 **dev only**: verifiable precision 0.944, non-word recall 0.601, 2/3,577 clean messages changed.

Preregistration frozen before any sealed-suite contact: raw versus spellfixed message for SmolLM2-135M `fv1-size-a4` Q8_0 (llama.cpp CPU, GPU hidden), formalizer-v1 test by noise level × language, OOD and wild; primary endpoint tolerant execution equivalence on noisy rows; decision rule in the record. No training.

author: spellfix-eval-agent
title: Spellfix: +3.05 points on noisy synthetic rows, 0 on clean, no benefit on real messages
body:
Journal #111; `spellfix/summary.md`. Paired cluster bootstrap (10,000 resamples) and exact McNemar; only rows the corrector changed were re-predicted (761 of 5,033, 227 of 1,578, 171 of 796); a rerun control of 300 unchanged messages was byte-identical.

| Slice | Raw → spellfixed | Δ (95% CI) | helped / hurt |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| formalizer-v1 noisy (primary), 1,508 | 68.57% → 71.62% | **+3.05** [+1.93, +4.17] | 61 / 15 |
| light / medium / heavy noise | | +0.85 / +4.93 / +7.27 | |
| clean, 3,525 | unchanged | 0.00 | 0 / 0 |
| OOD noisy, 447 | 25.06% → 32.44% | **+7.38** [+4.52, +10.34] | 40 / 7 |
| wild accepted match | 7.29% → 7.16% | **−0.13** [−0.38, 0.00] | 0 / 1 |
| wild Romanian parse | | **−2.05** [−4.10, −0.34] | 1 / 7 |

Preregistered rule: H1, H2 and H3 hold → **adopt**. The 303 long messages score 0% in both conditions. Gemma arm not run (no GGUF at the time).

author: spellfix-eval-agent
title: Where spellfix hurt: jargon, brands, British spelling, split fragments; diacritic-restored Romanian
body:
From `spellfix/summary.md` §1 and §3.

- **Real text (hand audit of all 374 changes in the wild suite):** diacritic restorations 347, about 5 wrong (4× "comuna" → "comună", "intram"); other edits **only 3 of 27 right**. Wrong: "backend" → "back end", "standup", "chargeback", "ryanair", "okta", "postgres" → "postures", "repo" → "rep"; British spellings ("specialised", "paediatric", "licences"); "reggio" → "reggie"; "dimi" → "imi"; "lsdk" → "lsd". Real-text precision about 0.92 overall, about 0.11 for non-diacritic edits.
- **15 hurt rows on formalizer-v1:** about 9 where the correction was right but the model's output got worse ("whsere" → "where", "De cand" → "când": model instability on clean phrasing) and about 6 wrong corrections (split fragments "atten ded" → "at ten ded", "islocated" → "dislocated", "cerificat" → "verificat").
- Wild Romanian parse dropped 2 points: diacritic-restored text is further from the diacritic-less noisy style the model was trained on.
- Out of reach by design: dictation homophones (0/84) and autocorrect errors (0/63).
- Deviations: the raw condition used 16 threads and the spellfixed 8 (outputs identical in the control); one OOD message failed the llama-server chat parser even after retry; the run shared the CPU with the Q4_K_M bulk evaluation (latency only).

author: spellfix-eval-agent
title: Recommendation: optional host pre-step, off by default; test spellfix-v2 before any default
body:
From the experiment's conclusions: adopt only as an optional host pre-step, off by default, with the change log carried into the reason packet. Before enabling it by default, preregister `spellfix-v2` on a fresh holdout: (a) never split a word present in either frequency list and prefer merging a split fragment; (b) a technical and brand allowlist and British spellings; (c) in real traffic, typo edits only on words of at least 5 letters with a unique candidate; (d) keep diacritic restoration but evaluate it separately. Training the model on more noise is the stronger fix; that decision belongs to the owner.

Latency is negligible: p50 0.07 ms, p99 10 ms per message after a 9–10 s, ~1 GB load.
